paper_title: Inhomogeneous Energy Injection in the 21-cm Power Spectrum: Sensitivity to Dark Matter Decay
notes: Pure sensitivity forecast: Fisher-matrix projections (via 21cmfish) of the constraints that upcoming HERA 21-cm power spectrum measurements will place on dark-matter decay lifetimes for chi->gamma gamma and chi->e+e- (Fig. 8, projected 95th-percentile lower limits on tau). The chi->gamma gamma channel would map onto the axion-photon plane, but the paper presents lifetime forecasts only, quotes no axion coupling, and derives no limit from existing data. Per task card, projections are out of scope, so no points are reported.
